name: dawn-dusk-line
author: 爱熬夜的人形兔
description: Time and environment awareness: time zone, exact timestamps, morning/noon/afternoon/evening/late night, and Chinese public holidays and make-up workdays (chinese-workday). It can add an awareness prefix to every LLM request. Also includes hourly greetings and a time lookup tool. Run npm install in the plugin folder.
